questions.solution: B satisfies the mandatory constraints and offers moderate impact; A exceeds budget and D lacks required feasibility assessment.

questions.question: Statement: The school should provide a digital copy of the timetable to parents. Assumptions: I. Parents may need convenient access to the timetable. II. Every parent owns a smartphone.

questions.question: In a ranking, R is above S but below T. U is below S but above V. Which order is necessarily correct from highest to lowest among these five?

questions.question: A public transport operator changed routes without consulting traffic data. Afterward, congestion increased at several intersections. Which explanation is most logically plausible?

The route change proves every intersection was affected
Congestion is unrelated to transport routes
The route change may have shifted traffic into already constrained intersections
questions.solution: A route change can redistribute traffic; the other statements are unsupported absolutes.

questions.solution: “thorough” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.solution: “demonstration” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.solution: “stationery” means writing materials; “stationary” means not moving.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The authority may _____ the application fee in exceptional cases.
questions.solution: “waive” means to give up or refrain from enforcing a requirement; “wave” refers to a gesture or moving swell.

questions.solution: “cite” is the verb meaning to refer to a source as evidence or authority.

questions.question: Choose the correctly placed modifier.
options: Walking to work, the rain soaked Maya.
The rain, walking to work, soaked Maya.
Walking to work, Maya was soaked by the rain.
Maya, the rain walking to work, was soaked.
questions.solution: Maya is the person walking to work, so the introductory modifier correctly refers to Maya.

questions.question: The reason ___ the project was delayed was lack of funding.
questions.solution: The standard construction is the reason why something happened.

questions.question: The decision was made ___ accordance with the law.
questions.solution: The fixed expression is in accordance with.

questions.question: The training focused on identifying risks, assessing impacts and ___ solutions.
questions.solution: The gerund sequence identifying, assessing, designing is parallel.

questions.question: The committee, together with its chairperson, ___ meeting tomorrow.
questions.solution: The main subject committee is singular; together with does not change the number.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'The committee approved the plan.'
options: The plan was approved by the committee.
The plan is approved the committee.
The committee was approved by the plan.
questions.solution: The object becomes the passive subject: The plan was approved by the committee.

questions.question: Unless you ___ the form, your application cannot be processed.
questions.solution: Unless introduces a real condition, so present simple is used for the future meaning.

questions.question: He said, 'I finished the work yesterday.' Choose the best reported form.
options: He said that he finished the work yesterday.
He said that he has finished the work tomorrow.
He said that I had finished the work.
He said that he had finished the work the previous day.
questions.solution: Past simple commonly shifts to past perfect and yesterday to the previous day.
